authorization_scope: Stage 3 defines future comparison only; Stage 4 execution requires approval.
purpose: Choose the manager implementation language for #9 using bounded native prototype evidence; no translator rewrite or game performance inference.
mandatory_gates: All common cases pass for both candidates against the declared subset and independent oracle.
No leaked synthetic secret or private path; output and execution bounded.
Native running slice and translation checks pass; owned child reaped, identities gone, unrelated sentinel survives.
Fresh source/binary identities and locked dependency integrity verified.
Any unresolved material functional, packaging or privacy requirement blocks adoption claims.
measurement_conditions: Same recorded host and power state; no concurrent heavy work.
Use isolated copies/output/state for each measurement; record actual command, source and config hashes.
Clean build output is not a cold OS cache; report filesystem and module-cache limitations.
Retain all valid unfavorable samples and all interrupted/failed attempts.
Apply functional gates before and after measurement; rerun affected checks after behavior changes.

build_samples.scope: Time each candidate native build command; prepare shared C object beforehand and account for it separately.
build_samples.edit_interpretation: Start from a built isolated candidate, replace the single comment sequentially, rebuild its native module, and retain compiler evidence of rebuild. Comment changes preserve behavior; they measure invalidation/recompilation overhead, not optimization quality or a typical code-edit workload.

launch_samples.order: Alternate rust,swift per pair; warmups separate and retained but unscored.
launch_samples.timed_scope: Native manager process start through its exit, including its validation, fixture launch and cleanup. Prepare bundle and run independent oracle outside timing.

metrics: All raw duration samples plus median/min/max
Available peak memory with units and collection limitations
Candidate binary, dependency cache and distribution payload sizes separately
Native slices, dynamic dependencies and inspected bundle/signing requirements
reporting.unknown: Use null plus explanation; do not invent unavailable metrics or tail distributions.

qualitative_rubric.evidence: Inspect native slices, dependencies, clean invocation and signing/bundle requirements. Inspection is not executed signing/distribution evidence.
Review unsafe/ABI surface, errors, process ownership, debugging and reproducibility. Shared C identity helper does not count as native supervision.
Review prerequisites, active dependency/license costs, custom parsers, organization and diagnostics. Source line counts are context, not an automatic score.
Interpret manager build/startup/memory results within scope; no automatic speed target or predetermined winner.

decision_rule: Apply mandatory gates first; explicitly weigh measured costs and qualitative evidence. Record unresolved requirements, reasons, alternative and reconsideration triggers. Do not turn prototype success into game support.
